questions.prompt: How many bits are in a MAC address? (a number)
What's the three-letter abbreviation for the first half of a MAC address, which identifies the manufacturer?
Which address is the Ethernet broadcast address?
3C-BD-C5-40-77-61 and 3cbd.c540.7761 are the same MAC address.
A MAC address starts with da:. What can you tell from that?
options: It's locally administered: probably a random, private address made up by the device's software

questions.prompt: A MAC address changes when a laptop moves from one network to another, the way its IP address does.
On Windows, what heading is the MAC address listed under in the network details?
Why do phones use a different random MAC address on each WiFi network?
options: To get a better IP address
Because the factory MAC wears out
So the device can't be tracked from network to network by its MAC address
